composition.seed: 7d80a570-c56b-4c48-892f-3463ccc40c82|1,1,0|I can’t establish or describe “The Spring of Unburied Green” as the current room: the verified location is X: 1, Y: 1, Z: 0, an uninhabited stretch of open ashland. Beneath Tartarus’s yellow sky, warm seepage has stained the black basalt a tender green where the sand thins, but no spring breaks the ground here. The wind makes a low, even hush across the dunes—until, for one breath, that hush seems to say nothing at all, and the silence rings sharper than any bell. Mortacia’s lost ledgers belong to the dead; still, their absence leaves a question in the living world of the afterlife: when a name is forgotten, is it lost, or merely waiting for someone to listen?

acceptedPlan.title: The Ashen Lullaby
acceptedPlan.rationale: A spacious, stepwise lament lets Tartarus’s hushed ashland breathe; two rising crests suggest the lost names gathering beneath the storm, then withdraw without mistaking silence for peace.
